name: Motocross Hoodie — Washed Taupe
description:
A number 07 dirt bike jumping over a red sun, with slanted FINAL HEAVEN lettering on the back. Small mark at the front hem.

Heavyweight 350 g washed cotton with a snow-wash finish, relaxed unisex fit. Printed to order, and the wash makes every one slightly different.

supplier.name: Suning Sufang Yazhi Clothing Co., Ltd.
